snip.t: Coagulopathy with bleeding: Give fresh frozen plasma or prothrombin complex concentrate if INR > 2.5 and bleeding; give vitamin K if deficiency suspected — Supplies clotting factors, corrects deficiency
Reverse drugs: Stop or hold antiplatelet agents (aspirin, clopidogrel) and anticoagulants; give vitamin K or prothrombin complex concentrate if warfarin‑related.
Give *fresh frozen plasma* (FFP) or *prothrombin complex concentrate* (PCC) for severe INR elevation or factor deficiency
Reversed by: Vitamin K (slow, over hours to days); FFP for urgent reversal; Prothrombin Complex Concentrate (PCC) for immediate reversal
